decision_summary: Navigator minimum sufficient statistics must be aggregate-only and non-leaking: run/manifest/evaluator fingerprints; public-strata family counts; external-anchor aggregate metrics; effect estimate with uncertainty; between-order/between-seed variance; risk non-regression; persistence across independent batches. Hidden item IDs, membership, content and per-item scores never return to Subject/selector.

Selector and evaluator are distinct roles/artifacts. Selector uses training/public validation only. Evaluator exclusively owns sealed hidden holdout plus independently owned real/external anchor partition. Candidate flows one-way into evaluator; only bounded aggregate verdict/statistics flow back. Same-model evaluator remains CORRELATED_BASELINE_ONLY.

Order/seed design must be pre-registered and family-blocked, using randomized permutations or Latin-square-style counterbalancing, mirror/inversion pairs, fixed observer version, and independent seed blocks. Report effect size, uncertainty, between-order variance and between-seed variance; every threshold/repetition count remains TEST_REQUIRED.

Jump/fountain stays screening-only. Persistent capability shift requires unseen-family hidden evaluation, external anchors, order/seed counterbalancing, rollback/replay reproducibility and risk non-regression. Three-window/local spikes or repeated exposure cannot qualify.

Rollback restores exact Subject overlay/selector state by checkpoint hash, while sealed evaluator holdout and audit live outside Subject rollback domain. Replay gets a new eval_run_id and cannot reveal prior hidden per-item outcomes.
